name: 蘇恆毅
objective: 本課程旨在使學生掌握電路學之基本原理與分析方法，並能應用所學進行各類電路問題之分析與計算。課程內容包括基本概念與定律、電路分析方法、電路定理，以及常見電路元件之特性與應用。
schedule:
Week 1-2: Basic Concepts
Week 3-4: Basic Laws 
Week 5-6: Methods of Analysis 
Week 7-8: Circuit Theorems
Week 9: Midterm Exam
Week 10-11: Capacitors and Inductors
Week 12-13: First-Order Circuits
Week 14-15: Second-Order Circuits
Week 16: Final Exam
scorePolicy:
小考: 30%
期中考: 30%
期末考: 40%
materials:
Charles K. Alexander and Matthew N. O. Sadiku, Fundamentals of Electric Circuits, 7th ed.
教師自編講義、例題與習題。
consultation: Email: hysu@ntut.edu.tw；亦可於課堂前後或另行預約時間討論。
